definite_issues.evidence: Slurm documents that an explicit variable list without ALL implicitly behaves as --get-user-env. It can backfill every omitted login variable; env -i only makes the seven named caller values take precedence and does not guarantee that PYTHONWARNINGS, loader hooks, BASH_ENV, or other omitted variables remain absent.
definite_issues.required_repair: Run sbatch under the seven-value env-i caller but use plain --export=ALL. SchedMD documents that this propagates only the already-clean caller environment and prevents implicit login-environment retrieval.

definite_issues.channel: Blanket remote extended-attribute prohibition on Lustre
definite_issues.evidence: The physical task path is Lustre. Ordinary newly created Lustre files and directories may carry filesystem-intrinsic layout metadata, so a literal no-remote-xattr condition cannot be guaranteed even when the workflow never sets a payload.
definite_issues.required_repair: Forbid user-controlled xattrs, nontrivial ACLs, and workflow layout mutation while tolerating automatically created intrinsic Lustre layout metadata remotely. Continue to require the copied local publication bundle to contain no xattrs.
